items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: I did used to hear a band by the name of Ezekiel Mack... I used to go down and sit down and listen to them and sit in some time

ctx.x: Were there any other bands before that, do you think, that played for dances? When you were a kid did you ever hear them from outside even?

Well, I did used to hear a band by the name of Ezekiel Mack from Boybick, Louisiana. He had a nice band but he was an older man than I was. I was, well, too young to play in his band. But I used to go down and sit down and listen to them and sit in some time, well they told me I had to go home, I was too young to stay out late at night like that.
Coming back for a moment to that, Jake Johnson, you said about how old would he be?
